newsitem.title: USA: Bids for U.S. nickel range $3.1600-$3.3600/lb.
newsitem.headline: Bids for U.S. nickel range $3.1600-$3.3600/lb.

text.p: Four firms bid to buy surplus U.S. nickel at a bid opening Thursday, with bids ranging from $3.1600 to $3.3600 per pound, the Defense National Stockpile Center said.
Keywell Corp was high bidder, bidding $3.3600 per pound for 80,000 pounds of nickel, the agency said. Keywell also bid $3.3400 for a further 80,000 pounds, and $3.3200 for the same quantity.
Considar Inc bid $3.3077 per pound for 500,000 pounds; Nickel Alloy Corp bid $3.3000 per pound for 40,000 pounds; and Thalheimer Brothers bid $3.1600 per pound for 39,690 pounds.
